newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Life soars on Swiss bourse.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Life soars on Swiss bourse.

text.p: Shares of newly-listed insurer Swiss Life have risen shaply in recent days, a trend which continued on Thursday, bourse traders said.
Swiss Life began trading on the Swiss bourse on July 3, after members of the mutual insurance company voted in June to convert the group into a public limited company.
The registered shares rose on Thursday afternoon by 135 Swiss francs, or by more than 18 percent, to 863 francs, the highest yet since trade began.
Volume was 101,000 shares, after 62,988 shares traded Wednesday.

Bourse traders were unsure what factors contributed to the rise. One said the shares gained after a positive article on the company appeared in the Wednesday edition of Swiss newspaper "Finanz und Wirtschaft."
The paper noted studies which projected a long-term target for Swiss Life shares of 900 Swiss francs.
But some traders and analysts considered the shares appeared to be over-valued.
